mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task ( task_id, user_id, trace_id, created_by_task_id, status, source, depth, agent_id, context_text, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{userId}, #{traceId}, #{createdByTaskId}, #{status}, #{source}, #{depth}, #{agentId}, #{context}, #{createdAt, typeHandler=com.agentcrossing.platform.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{updatedAt, typeHandler=com.agentcrossing.platform.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id), trace_id = VALUES(trace_id), created_by_task_id = VALUES(created_by_task_id), status = VALUES(status), source = VALUES(source), depth = VALUES(depth), agent_id = VALUES(agent_id), context_text = VALUES(context_text), created_at = VALUES(created_at), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT candidate.task_id, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM task_dependency d LEFT JOIN task parent ON parent.task_id = d.parent_task_id WHERE d.child_task_id = candidate.task_id AND (parent.task_id IS NULL OR parent.status IN ('FAILED', 'BLOCKED', 'CANCELED')) ) AS dependency_blocked, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM task_dependency d JOIN task parent ON parent.task_id = d.parent_task_id WHERE d.child_task_id = candidate.task_id AND parent.status != 'COMPLETED' ) AS dependency_waiting, (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM invocation i WHERE i.user_id = candidate.user_id AND i.agent_id = candidate.agent_id AND i.status = 'RUNNING' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM task running WHERE running.user_id = candidate.user_id AND running.agent_id = candidate.agent_id AND running.status = 'PROCESSING' )) AS agent_busy, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chat_thread thread JOIN agent_session_history h ON h.thread_id = thread.thread_id AND h.user_id = thread.user_id WHERE thread.trace_id = candidate.trace_id AND thread.user_id = candidate.user_id AND h.agent_id = candidate.agent_id AND h.provider = candidate.agent_id AND h.status = 'COMPACTING' ) AS session_compacting FROM task candidate WHERE candidate.status = 'QUEUED' AND candidate.task_id IN #{taskId}
SELECT * FROM task WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM task ORDER BY created_at ASC, task_id ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM task WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
